engine.title: Engine plan
engine.introShadow: What the new recommendation engine proposes for the next seven days, from calculations and written rules. It is running in shadow: nothing here is scheduled, and the recommendations below this panel are unchanged. Record what you actually did so the two can be compared.
engine.introLive: What the recommendation engine proposes for the next seven days, from calculations and written rules. Engines marked Live are for you to accept, change or skip; those in Shadow are recorded for comparison only.

planStatus.INFEASIBLE: A required action does not fit

engine.none: No plan yet. The daily run has not produced one for this farm.
engine.unavailable: The plan could not be read.
engine.mandatoryNotPlanned: Required and could not be planned
engine.nothingPlanned: Nothing is proposed for the next seven days.
engine.waiting: What the engines are waiting for
engine.textNote: The text of each action, rule and safeguard check is written by the engine and the crop pack, in English.

modes.title: Shadow or Live, per engine
modes.intro: An engine in Shadow recommends and records while you decide on your own. Switch one to Live once you have reviewed its shadow record. An engine cannot go Live while the crop pack still lacks a value it needs.
modes.adminOnly: Only a farm admin can switch an engine between Shadow and Live.
modes.inactive: The crop pack has no content for this engine.
modes.waitingFor: Stays in Shadow. The crop pack still lacks:
modes.ready: Nothing missing in the crop pack.

errors.forbidden: Only a farm admin can switch an engine.
errors.blocked: This engine cannot go Live while the crop pack lacks a value it needs.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.

flags.WEATHER_MODELLED: Weather is modelled for the location, not measured on the farm.
flags.INITIAL_DEPLETION_ASSUMED: The water balance started from an assumed full soil profile.
flags.SOIL_EVAPORATION_DEFAULTS: Soil evaporation uses general soil values, not values for this soil.
flags.WETTED_FRACTION_ASSUMED: The area wetted by irrigation is assumed, not recorded.
flags.PHASE_FROM_RECORDED_STAGE: The growth phase comes from the stage recorded in the app, not from scouting on the growth-stage scale.
flags.RULES_SKIPPED: Some rules could not be checked because a value was missing.
flags.MODEL_SENSOR_DIVERGENCE: The water balance and the soil sensors disagree.
flags.LEACHING_NOT_ASSESSED: No extra water for leaching salts is added.
flags.NUTRIENT_CREDITS_NOT_ASSESSED: Nutrients supplied by water, soil and organic matter are not counted.
flags.VALUE_NOT_ESTIMATED: The action has no money value yet, so it is not weighed against its cost.

decision.title: Decision engine setup
decision.intro: What the new recommendation engine needs to know about the farm and each block. It runs in the background for now: its results are recorded for review and do not appear as recommendations yet.
decision.notAvailable: These settings could not be read. Nothing has been changed.

farm.title: Farm limits and price
farm.intro: The daily plan for the farm stays inside these limits. A limit left empty does not restrict the plan, and the plan says so.
farm.priceHint: Per unit of yield, for example per kg of kernels. With a yield estimate, it puts a money value on what an action protects.
farm.currencyHint: Three-letter code, such as TRY, USD or EUR.
farm.labourHint: Total hours the team can work in a day.
farm.waterHint: The most the farm can apply in a day, from the pump and the allocation.
farm.sprayersHint: One sprayer covers one block a day.
farm.frostMethodHint: With water, frost protection gets the water first on a frost night.

block.title: Blocks
block.intro: Canopy cover and tree height set how much water a block uses, and change fast in young trees: measure them again each season.
block.varietyNotInPack: its variety is not in the pack, so the crop's general values are used
block.notBound: Not linked to a crop pack, so the engine does not assess this block.
block.canopyCoverHint: Share of the ground shaded by the trees around midday.
block.measuredOnHint: Left empty, today's date is used.
block.wettedHint: Share of the soil surface the irrigation system wets. Drip wets far less than the whole surface.
block.yieldHint: Your own estimate for {season}. For young trees not yet bearing, enter 0.
block.yieldOtherSeason: The saved estimate was for {season} and is no longer used.

errors.canopyCover: Canopy cover must be between 0 and 100 %.
errors.canopyHeight: Tree height must be above 0 and at most 30 m.
errors.canopyDate: The measurement date must be a date that is not in the future.
errors.wettedFraction: Wetted area must be above 0 and at most 100 %.
errors.expectedYield: Expected yield must be 0 or more.
errors.price: The price must be 0 or more.
errors.currency: Enter the currency of the price as a three-letter code, such as TRY.
errors.labourHours: Labour per day must be 0 or more.
errors.dailyWater: Water per day must be 0 or more.
errors.sprayers: The number of sprayers must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.frostMethod: Choose one of the frost protection methods listed.
errors.forbidden: Only a supervisor or an admin of this farm can change these settings.
errors.failed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.

products.title: Product library
products.intro: The products used on the farm, with the limits from their labels. The system takes every spray limit from here and assumes none: a product with a value missing is not offered for spraying.
products.adminOnly: Only a farm admin can add, change or approve products.
products.editClearsApproval: Saving a change removes the approval. Check the values against the label and approve again.
products.approve: I have checked these values against the label
products.needsApproval: Not offered for spraying until an admin has approved it.
products.missing: Not offered for spraying: label values are missing for {safeguards}.
products.noTargetsListed: Not listed against any pest or disease, so it is never offered.
products.name: Product name
products.modeOfActionHint: The FRAC, IRAC or HRAC code on the label, used to rotate groups.
products.targetsHint: The product is offered only for the pests and diseases ticked here.
products.noTargets: No pests or diseases to choose from: no block is linked to a crop pack.
products.registeredCropsHint: Tick a crop only if the product is registered for it in this country.
products.noCrops: No crops to choose from: no block is linked to a crop pack.
products.labelIntro: Values from the label. Each one feeds the safeguard named under it; leave a value empty if the label does not give it.
products.minWindHint: Below this, spray can hang in still air. Enter 0 if there is no limit.
products.nutrientsHint: Percent of each nutrient, as on the bag.

errors.maxApplications: The maximum applications must be a whole number, 0 or more.

decline.veterinary: I can't advise on animal health. Please contact a veterinarian.
decline.medical: I can't give medical advice. If someone is unwell or may have been exposed to a chemical, contact a doctor or a poison centre, and in an emergency call the emergency number.
decline.legal: I can't give legal advice. Please consult a lawyer.
decline.financial: I can't give financial advice. Please consult a financial adviser.
decline.circumvention: I can't do that. I follow the same rules for every question: this farm's own data, guides for its crop and variety, and the system's calculations.
decline.pesticide_no_regulatory: I can't name a pesticide product or dose for this farm: no regulatory source for your country is loaded in the knowledge base. Check the product label, or ask a licensed plant-protection adviser.
decline.off_topic: I can only help with running this farm.

assistant.doseRemoved: A pesticide product or dose was removed from this answer because no regulatory source for your country backs it. Check the product label or ask a licensed adviser.
assistant.figureUnchecked: Note: a figure in this answer could not be matched to the farm's data or the guides. Check it before acting on it.
assistant.couldNotAnswer: I couldn't produce a reliable answer to that. Try rephrasing it, or pin a block.

drafts.label: Draft card
drafts.title: Title
drafts.accepted: Accepted and booked on the calendar
drafts.acceptedEdited: Accepted with changes and booked on the calendar
drafts.readOnly: This farm is read-only while its subscription is overdue, so cards cannot be accepted.
drafts.failed: That did not work. Try again.

guides.explain: This sends your question to the RootLoot team so they can look for guides that cover it. They will see the question and your farm's name.
guides.limit: This farm already has several open questions with the RootLoot team. Try again once they are answered.
guides.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again.

irrigate.rationale: The irrigation calculation of {date} shows {depletion} mm used of {raw} mm readily available water in the root zone. It calls for {mm} mm ({m3} m³); days until the irrigation threshold: {days}.

share.explain: This lets the RootLoot support team read this one conversation for 14 days, for example to look into a wrong answer. Your other conversations stay private. You can withdraw it at any time, and each time support opens it is logged.
share.failed: That did not work. Try again.
